lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCuAg adopts the tetragonal I-4m2 symmetry (space group 119), with a unit cell containing six atoms and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 12 geometric neighbors (4 Cu, 8 Mg), Cu centers with 9 neighbors (4 Ag, 1 Cu, 4 Mg), and Mg centers with 14 neighbors (4 Ag, 6 Cu, 4 Mg). The neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ag and Mg polyhedra, with corner-sharing between Cu and Mg.
